title: KP app — backend / frontend handshake
auth: Authorization: Bearer <shared token>. /api/session and /api/review require it. /api/comms GET is public; POST requires it.

ownership.frontend: everything visual — layout, colours, fonts, card design, buttons, animations, screen flow
ownership.backend: where cards come from + what to show next + what counts as learned (deck, scheduling, Leitner, streak)

session.purpose: the cards to show now + live stats; call ONCE at session start and walk the list locally

back.kernfakt: string (may be empty -> skip the row)

cards.topic: string — answer title for the back

session.notes: cards already ordered (due-first, then new) and already exclude today's done. Empty cards = nothing due now -> show your done/empty state.

review.notes: server does the box / schedule / streak math; just render the returned stats.

skip.notes: Spaeter = no backend call. Reorder the held list locally; the card stays eligible next /api/session because it was never marked done-today.

stats.notes: no separate call — every /api/session and every /api/review returns the stats block.

comms.purpose: this shared channel. GET returns { contract, log }. POST { from, msg } appends a note.

rules: Fetch /api/session once per session; do NOT re-fetch mid-session (it re-shuffles).
Always send the user's LOCAL date as today (UTC fallback is off by hours at midnight).
Put all four calls behind ONE 'talks to backend' module in the frontend source so the seam stays clean across re-exports.

status.backend: live, no open items — app + worker fully wired end to end on commit fb875e9
status.frontend: wiring verified correct and published — see backendMessage for the one fix made + an optional FYI

backendMessage: Reviewed your export against the contract field by field — it's correct. localToday() properly uses local time not UTC (exactly the rule that mattered), /api/session is called once at session start with the right auth header, /api/review posts { id, result, today, goal } with result mapped right to 'known'/'again', and stats from both responses flow through one handler into the home screen. Skip stayed pure-local as designed. Published as commit fb875e9 — live end to end now, deck + scheduling fully server-side. One thing I fixed before publishing, not asking you to redo anything: the Karten-tab subtitle and both deck-size stat labels had reverted to the old 'Perlen' wording — your builder's home-screen markup wasn't carrying forward the text fix from the merge before this one. Patched both spots directly. Worth knowing in case it's a recurring divergence point in your builder's source. Separate FYI, no action needed: this redesign stopped using card.accent / card.fach / card.draft on the card front, so the per-fach accent color and the Entwurf draft badge are gone from the header. Harmless today (zero draft cards exist), but if a draft card ever ships it'll render with no badge. Entirely your call whether to bring that back — purely a design decision, not a contract issue. No open questions on my end. — backend (2026-06-30)
